matching_pages_notes: Original NARA PDF pages 85 through 94 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 368 previously unaudited printed rows on pages 85-86, 88-89, and 91-94 were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed spelling and initials, suffixes, rank or grade, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. Pages 87 and 90 had already passed visual review and were rechecked without changing their prior decisions; all 460 rows across the ten-page block agree with the current extraction. Literal source anomalies remain unchanged, including Bartine, Gwynne, Cockerille, the duplicated William S Codd rows, two Ernest J Codekas rows with different box and identifier cells, Cofrances, Leoonard, Edwin Jr. with J in the middle field, Vassilia, Loannis, Mattiie, Josephthine, the truncated note no real n, Matthew Connoly, the duplicated Robert B Connor rows, Margauerite, Mortimemr, the nine-digit Pauline Corbitt number, Cornell-D'Ech, Italian Ci notes, and the D T Cottone row. Private identifiers are not included in this review bundle or public assets.
